Bolaji designed and implemented an enterprise metrics governance framework, establishing a single source of truth for business metrics. This included creating a centralized metrics catalog documenting KPI derivations, relationships, and calculation formulas, which standardized KPI computation through reusable BigQuery and Dataform assets. His work also resolved long-standing reporting disputes between Finance, Operations, and Product by setting a governance bar across over 250 production pipelines.
The framework across five markets is relevant. What measured adoption or efficiency result came from his self-service analytics work, and what was the denominator and time period?

Bolaji's self-service analytics work, specifically the Gozem Data Hub, served over 700 people including employees, field agents, and partners across five African countries by the end of his mandate. Two engineers he onboarded subsequently shipped two additional self-service apps onto the platform. I don't have information about information on measured adoption or efficiency results from his self-service analytics work, nor the denominator and time period for such results. It does mention the number of people served by the Gozem Data Hub and the number of additional self-service apps shipped. You may be able to find more information by emailing hello@bolablg.com.
